data.title: Getafe vs Rayo Vallecano Prediction, Tip and Match Preview - Monday 19th October 2026 - Spain La Liga
Getafe vs Rayo Vallecano - prediction, preview & betting tips - 19/10/2026
data.content:
Despite sitting 14th in La Liga with eight points from eight matches, Getafe are dangerously close to the drop, holding a fragile one-point cushion over 18th-placed Elche.

Christantus Uche(cruciate ligament) and Zaid Romero (muscle) are both confirmed out, while Orel Mangala, Ramon Terrats, Ivan Azon, and Enes Unal will all need late fitness tests to determine their availability for this clash. [...] Moreover, Benat San Jose's troops have had an excellent track record against their hosts in recent years, as they are undefeated in 11 consecutive skirmishes between these outfits (W4, D7).

Rayo remain without first-choice goalkeeper Augusto Batalla, who is out long-term with a broken leg. Luiz Felipe (cruciate ligament) and Andrei Ratiu (muscle injury) are also sidelined, with the latter expected to make a full recovery later this month. [...] Although Getafe are unbeaten at home this season, they have not beaten Rayo Vallecano in six years. Keeping in mind that seven of the last 11 H2Hs ended in stalemates, we believe the spoils will be shared between these teams after 90 minutes.

Rayo's last seven games have all featured goals at both ends, and this can be backed at 23/20 (2.15).

We also fancy under 2.5 total goals at 3/5 (1.60), as was the case in six of Getafe's last seven matches and in each of the last nine H2Hs.
